text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan (Barang-Barang

Kawalan) (No. 6) 2017.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai barang-barang

kawalan bagi tempoh dari 23 Disember 2017 hingga 27 Disember 2017.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing tempatan bertulang

2. Daging kambing import bertulang

3. Daging biri-biri import bertulang

4. Ayam belanda import

5. Tomato

6. Kepak ayam

7. Lada benggala hijau

8. Babi hidup

9. Daging babi (perut)

10. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 13 Disember 2017

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/X]

 DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 6) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 6) Order 2017.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for the

period from 23 December 2017 to 27 December 2017.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local bone-in mutton

2. Imported bone-in mutton

3. Imported bone-in lamb

4. Imported turkey

5. Tomato

6. Chicken wing

7. Green capsicum

8. Live pig

9. Pork (belly)

10. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 13 December 2017

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/X]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

 Minister of Domestic Trade,

Co-operatives and Consumerism
